verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents a self-serve dashboard opt-out from its model improvement program, alongside TTL controls for audio and transcripts, which directly lets users keep their data out of training. An older community note that the privacy policy permits training use describes the default posture; it does not contradict the existence of the opt-out. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on opt-out scope (e.g. whether it covers streaming data and applies retroactively, plus default behavior), independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.
